integrity.mathematical_claim: Exact all-order coefficients, local support classification, and sharp dimension thresholds

scientific_limitations: The concept family consists only of open graph neighborhoods on Cartesian products of nontrivial finite paths.
All-binary path boxes are Hamming graphs; the complete Hamming case is credited to earlier work.
Equivalent formulas in unindexed or unavailable literature remain possible; no absolute priority is asserted.
Finite enumeration supplements, but does not replace, the all-parameter proof.
title: Boundary-sensitive shattering of open neighborhoods in Cartesian path boxes
